title: DynEdit: Dynamic Entropy-Guided Sequential Editing for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information

translated_title: DynEdit：面向大语言模型的动态熵引导序列编辑
translated_abstract: 知识编辑旨在更新大语言模型中过时或错误的知识，而无需进行完整的重新训练。现有的参数编辑方法在处理长序列知识时仍然存在局限：单点编辑器对扩展目标的覆盖不足，而基于固定分块的编辑器则在僵化的预定义窗口内均匀分配编辑力度，无法优先处理困难且信息密集的词元。在本工作中，我们发现词元熵与编辑难度和语义重要性密切相关：高熵区域更难编辑，且通常包含关键的事实内容。基于这一观察，我们提出了DynEdit，一个用于长序列知识编辑的动态框架。DynEdit利用词元级熵来引导非均匀滑动，增加对困难高熵区域的覆盖，并进一步应用熵引导的词元级优化，以加强对信息密集内容的更新。
tldr: 提出DynEdit框架，发现词元熵与编辑难度及语义重要性密切相关，并利用熵引导的非均匀滑动和词元级优化来提升大语言模型长序列知识编辑的覆盖与效果。
en_tdlr: DynEdit proposes a dynamic entropy-guided framework for long-sequence knowledge editing in LLMs, leveraging token entropy as a signal of editing difficulty and semantic importance to prioritize difficult, information-dense regions.
